author: Bobby Grayson
description: Verified: alice and bob each ran 'lean import' on the same export, bob had an extra node so local ids differed, bob replayed alice's events: 193 nodes / 284 edges exactly as expected, no duplicate declarations, alice's decision attached to bob's thm:conway-refinement.
title: Deterministic change_id per blueprint id makes Lean collaboration free: two users import independently, exchange only reasoning events, and decisions land on the same declarations
